provenance.description: United States Coast Guard boat electrical-system regulation, 33 CFR Part 183 Subpart I: allowable amperage of conductors (Table 5 to section 183.425), the engine-space correction factors (Table 5 note 1) and the bundling correction factors (Table 5 note 2, applied by section 183.435(b) to circuits of 50 volts or more). Numeric values only.
provenance.standard: 33 CFR 183.425, Table 5, as in force 2025-07-01 (unchanged since the original rule, 42 FR 5944, 31 January 1977)

sources.what: eCFR, Office of the Federal Register
Federal Register final rule CGD 73-217, 42 FR 5944

provenance.cross_check: All four sources agree on every cell. The outside-engine-space table, the bundling factors and the 75 C to 200 C engine-space factors are identical to the ABYC E-11 Table 6A values in data/e11.json; the one difference is 60 C in engine spaces, which E-11 does not permit and 33 CFR 183.425 permits at 0.58.
provenance.scope: Applies to boats under 33 CFR Part 183 (recreational boats with electrical systems, section 183.401). Bundling factors are mandatory only for conductors carrying 50 volts or more (section 183.435(b)); section 183.430 imposes no bundling derate on lower-voltage conductors.
